title: Make the auth proxy redirect page visits only
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-out visit to a private page redirects (307) to `/login?next=<path and query>`
A signed-in visit to `/login` or `/signup` redirects to `/`
A `POST` (a Server Action call) is never redirected, signed in or not
Files under `/_next/` and paths ending in a file name with an extension, like `/logo.png`, are never redirected
